purpose: Determine whether the v0.72 direct-power mismatch is caused by reconstructing CLASS total-matter power from raw component perturbations with a convention that differs from the native CLASS delta_m source used by the Fourier module. Audit the native source before any further nonlinear-onset interpretation.
historical_results_policy: v0.67-v0.72 classifications remain unchanged. This audit cannot retroactively promote a historical FAIL.

frozen_physical_model.forcing: same positive-Drude eta=0 variational forcing construction as v0.72

fixed_grid.provenance: v0.63 preregistered RSD grid; unchanged from v0.72

class_definition_audit.native_matter_source: CLASS perturbations source delta_m, which is the source selected by fourier.c for P_m
class_definition_audit.native_gauge_policy: matter_source_in_current_gauge remains at the CLASS default false, so delta_m is converted to the gauge-invariant form delta_m + 3 a H theta_m/k^2
class_definition_audit.power_identity: for the single adiabatic scalar initial condition, P_m = (2 pi^2/k^3) delta_m_source^2 P_R(k)
class_definition_audit.raw_component_reconstruction: the v0.72 Dm reconstruction from delta_b, delta_cdm, delta_ncdm and theta variables is retained only as a diagnostic comparator

manual_component_diagnostic.reason: v0.73 is intended to locate the convention mismatch; the manual reconstruction is not allowed to veto a native-source closure result

classification_logic.V073_NATIVE_SOURCE_AFFINITY_FAIL: native source power closes to pk_lin but native tangent affinity fails
classification_logic.V073_NATIVE_SOURCE_POWER_CLOSURE_FAIL: native source-derived power does not close to pk_lin
classification_logic.V073_CLASS_MATTER_SOURCE_AUDIT_FAIL: forcing, requested-k, finiteness, or another required numerical condition fails

interpretation_policy: A closure result certifies the CLASS matter-source convention and tangent numerics on the fixed theory grid only. It is not an observational detection, does not perform nonlinear evolution, and does not itself certify the v0.67-v0.71 nonlinear-onset interpretation.
